text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's New Year's. As per usual, compared
with other
Umamusume, Agnes
Tachyon's enthusiasm
towards racing is
on the low end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All the same, we set our goal for this
year as
winning the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know her lack of enthusiasm isn't due
to a lack
of motivation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After all, if her goal is to reach even
faster
speeds, she'll have to enter some
races to do
that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I grab a brush and some ink to try my
hand at
some motivational calligraphy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's just like you to insist we have a
meeting this
early into the new year.
Though...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She notices the calligraphy I'm working
on.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What do we have here? "The Classic
Triple
Crown."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right! I do remember you telling me
that! The
prospects look positive!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Though, as I have been saying, I cannot

guarantee that I will actually enter any
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she's going to race, now would be the
time for
us to start getting the ball
rolling.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm. You're saying it would be a waste to
not
utilize the Classics, correct?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If so, you make a valid point. Competing
with
powerhouse Umamusume could be
the key to a
new breakthrough in my
research.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Although, like I have said in the past, or
actually
just now, I—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Heh-heh! Aren't you a persistent one?
So you
wish for me to race this badly?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smiling, she brings her hand to her chin
and goes
into deep thought.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Well, you might have a point. Okay. I
will make
arrangements for the Satsuki
Sho then.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's a heartfelt wish from my dear
guinea—Trainer!
It would pain me to turn
you down time and time
again.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the chance to collect data is an

attractive proposition!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
While we're at it, should we try to think
of
strategies for the Yayoi Sho as well as
the Satsuki
Sho?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Wipe that shocked look from your face. I
am not
the one-dimensional character
you presume me to
be.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Even a lab rat gets treats, if you know
what I
mean. Anyway, what are we going
to do now?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! Then we shall commence our
strategy
meeting!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
First, let us determine the possible
contenders for
the Yayoi Sho this year.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Once we've learned their strengths,
weaknesses,
and personalities, we can
input that data into the
simulation and
run scrimmages in VR!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But then there's motor imagery, which,

statistically speaking, is proven to
contribute to
success in various matters.
We may not even need
to run
simulations.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A fifty-meter dash or even a hurdle race
would be
good... But wait, what if we
compiled all of the
girls' data into a
chimera-like entity?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If we configure the settings to randomly
assemble
different parts of their body,
can you imagine
what kinds of
composites we'd give birth to? We
could
mix their internal organs as well!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, how exhilarating! Let's hurry to the
lab! I'm
appointing you as my assistant
for the day!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spend the rest of the day monitoring
her
research and keeping her from
breaking any
scientific code of ethics.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? You mean you want to relax and
savor the
mood of New Year's together?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? You know I'm not used to
this kind
of thing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, I suppose that is true. The high
sugar
content will prove valuable as a
source of energy
for the brain and
training.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, wait. Why go to such lengths with
this
inefficient method of ingestion when
I can just
take glucose directly?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that settles it. Guinea pig, fetch me
some
glucose tablets from the shops
over there!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
While you're at it, get some vitamin B9
and iron
supplements too! Oh, and
ethanol!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And just like that, I spend the rest of
New Year's
Day running her personal
errands.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Pray to the shrine, you say? To be frank,
I'm not
so familiar with the custom.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Don't get me wrong, I find it quite
interesting. At
the end of the day, it
comes down to a
reaffirmation of
sentiment, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Wait a moment... If you make a wish, this
may
present me an opportunity to
observe its placebo
effect up close!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The first shrine visit of New Year's
doesn't
sound bad at all! What are you
waiting for? Let's
go!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And we must get fortune slips too while
we're at
it! Great fortune or great
misfortune would be
ideal!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While we're at the shrine, she pesters me

relentlessly about the wishes I made.
